selection: At most three evenly spaced complete reference-valid 60 s windows each from activity 1 (sitting) and 8 (working), with >=8 s real PPG context. No model predictions used.
method: Original positive-pulse Elgendi implementation; subtract candidate lag before fixed core crop; maximum-cardinality event agreement at 100ms; candidates -5 to +5 s at1/64s; ties smallest absolute lag.
interpretation: Post hoc training-only timing diagnostic. Wide-lag event agreement has periodic aliases and does not identify physiological PAT, device delay, or synchronize held-out people. No correction is applied.
